bullets.text: Enhanced Incident Response Services - **Microsoft** introduces proactive services to bolster organizational resilience against cyber incidents.
Phishing Attack Vector Exploited - **Microsoft** warns of phishing actors using complex routing to spoof domains and deliver deceptive emails.
Defender Experts Suite Launched - **Microsoft** unveils a new suite providing expert-led services to combat advanced cyberthreats.
Strategic AI Datacenter Planning - **Microsoft** showcases seamless integration of NVIDIA Rubin platform into Azure's AI infrastructure.
Osmos Acquisition Announced - **Microsoft** acquires Osmos to enhance autonomous data engineering capabilities within **Microsoft Fabric**.
